recipe.title: Velvet Orchestra
recipe.summary: A thief returns five stolen things through brass slots; gravity leans toward the last stone touched, a radio dial rewrites the rules, and every sound draws a Listener to a new slot.
teaches: gravity direction faked by repeating impulses gated on a var
noise var + listener that blocks a slot

radio_set.desc: a walnut cabinet radio with a brass grille and a glass dial

listener.desc: the patient listener: a draped tall figure, one huge ear turned to the room

return_slot.desc: a brass-framed slot in the wall where returned things leave the hall

lode_plinth.desc: a velvet plinth with a glowing ring: touch the stone on it and the room leans toward it

music_stand.desc: a brass music stand with a sheet

objective.text: 88.1 Static: the room leans gently. Touch a glowing stone (E) to make it the weight; turn the dial (E on the teal can) to change the rules
94.5 Waltz: the lean is a rush. Touch a stone, everything slides toward it. Push the stolen things out of a brass slot
101.2 Hush: no lean, no noise. Bat things by hand while the listener stands at a slot
107.7 Inverse: everything is pushed AWAY from the last stone you touched

start.title: Velvet Orchestra
start.text: Tonight you return everything you ever stole. Push five things out through the brass slots. Gravity points toward the last glowing stone you touched, and the teal radio can (E) changes a rule of the room. Every touch, swing and turn of the dial is noise; noise draws the Listener to a different slot each time. Let him hear you three times and the night ends.

victory.title: Nothing left but you
victory.text: The hall is bare. The radio hums to itself.

lose.title: Heard
lose.text: The Listener turned his ear to you three times.

sim.name: mechanic: dial turns the rule, a stone turns gravity, things slide east
each slot takes only its own things: east pull returns the crate and plant, not the chair
hush silences the touch: dial to 101 then stones make no noise
inverse dial: touching the west stone pushes the room east
the listener stands in the west slot: a thing pushed in is handed back and the lean stops
noise draws the listener and he is heard three times: lose
win: waltz west, east, north, one slot at a time
